_comment: Contacts database (Jira Standard plan has no place for phone/position, so it lives here). Keyed by Jira Service Management organization id - the same orgId used in org-mapping.json. Exactly one contact per org should have isPrimary:true; that person becomes the To: recipient on all ticket emails for that org, with the original email sender (Jira reporter) moved to Cc. Get orgId from: GET /rest/servicedeskapi/organization
